proposals.title: Slides LowCode controlled pilot: Convert + Merger (defer ForEach/Collect)
proposals.problem: Slides has 5 confirmed WORKFLOW_ROOT types. Convert and Merger have file-path overloads suitable for pilot. ForEach/Collect require delegate callbacks and should be deferred. XML docs are MISSING, requiring compensating code templates.
acceptance_criteria: slides.yml status changed to experimental with allowed_types=[Convert, Merger]
preferred_methods_per_type set: Convert->ToPdf, Merger->Process
Programmatic PPTX fixtures registered and validated
Few-shot code templates added to compensate for missing XML docs
At least 1 example passes full E2E (build+run+reviewer)
PR dry-run package created
Denominator JSON created for slides
blockers: XML docs missing - few-shot templates must be created first

proposals.title: Diagram programmatic fixture strategy: VSDX generation via Aspose.Diagram.Diagram()
proposals.problem: Diagram pilot needs VSDX input fixtures. No fixtures exist. Must validate that Aspose.Diagram.Diagram() can programmatically create minimal VSDX files (single page with rectangle shape).
acceptance_criteria: Programmatic VSDX fixture validated via standalone C# harness (similar to PDF harness)
Fixture types defined: programmatic_vsdx_single (1 page), programmatic_vsdx_multi_page (2+ pages)
Fixture registered in fixture-registry.json
DiagramConverter.Process and PdfConverter.Process validated with programmatic fixture

proposals.problem: Email pilot needs EML/MSG input fixtures. No fixtures exist. Must validate that Aspose.Email.MailMessage can create minimal email files and that the async Converter + FolderOutputHandler pattern works end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: Programmatic EML/MSG fixture validated via standalone C# harness
Fixture types defined: programmatic_eml_single, programmatic_msg_single
Async Converter.ConvertToMsg + FolderOutputHandler validated in harness
Fixture registered in fixture-registry.json

proposals.title: Slides programmatic fixture strategy: PPTX generation via Aspose.Slides.Presentation()
proposals.problem: Slides pilot needs PPTX input fixtures. No fixtures exist. Must validate that Aspose.Slides.Presentation() can create minimal PPTX files and that Convert.ToPdf and Merger.Process work with them.

proposals.title: Slides XML docs compensation: few-shot code templates for LLM generation
proposals.problem: Aspose.Slides.NET NuGet package does not include XML documentation file. LLM code generation and example-reviewer both have reduced context. Need explicit few-shot code templates in the packet builder to compensate.
acceptance_criteria: Few-shot code templates created for Convert.ToPdf, Convert.AutoByExtension, Merger.Process
Templates included in LLM prompt when family=slides
Generated code correctly uses static class methods (not instance)
Test validates that slides packet includes compensating templates
